source_claim: The official Digimon Encyclopedia profiles identify Beelzemon: Blast Mode, Dukemon: Crimson Mode (English listing: Gallantmon: Crimson Mode), Flamedramon, and MetalGreymon as Digimon.
notes: The checked first-party profile URLs are https://digimon.net/reference_en/detail.php?directory_name=beelzebumonblastmode ; https://digimon.net/reference_en/detail.php?directory_name=dukemoncrimsonmode ; https://digimon.net/reference_en/detail.php?directory_name=fladramon ; https://digimon.net/reference_en/detail.php?directory_name=metalgreymon .
